scripts.dev: npm run api:types && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.api:types: uv run --directory .. python -m item_compare.openapi web/openapi.json && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/lib/api/schema.ts
scripts.api:check: npm run api:types && git diff --exit-code -- openapi.json src/lib/api/schema.ts
